dedupe_keys.name: doe pnnl prototype building models commercial residential and manufactured housing energyplus

description: The DOE Building Energy Codes Program publishes prototype building models that Pacific Northwest National Laboratory uses to simulate the energy savings of changes in commercial and residential energy codes and standards, for evaluating published codes and developing proposed changes. The commercial suite covers 75% of U.S. commercial floor area for new construction, including mid- to high-rise residential buildings, with 16 building types in 19 climate locations (16 in the U.S. and 3 international) for recent editions of ASHRAE Standard 90.1, its Appendix G performance rating method and the IECC, 5,168 models in all in EnergyPlus version 22.1.0. Each zipped package holds EnergyPlus input files (.idf) and output files (.htm) across all locations plus a scorecard spreadsheet of building descriptions, internal loads and schedules, with TMY3 weather files for the 19 locations; separate residential and manufactured housing prototype sets are also offered. Coverage: U.S. climate zones and three international locations. Access: free downloads. Licence: U.S. government work. Caveats: prototypes represent code-minimum new construction, not the existing stock. Simulation uses are archetype inputs for building energy, code impact and retrofit simulations. Related records: the DOE commercial reference buildings, EnergyPlus and ComStock.
